summary: Assist to Archuleta County SAR with two Alpine RT teams for a search for a missing ~70-year-old man in the Blackhead Peak area (2023-082).
location: Blackhead Peak area, San Juan Mountains
responding_agency: Alpine Rescue Team (assist to Archuleta County SAR)
notes: Mission page is a one-liner (06:30 page time). Likely the multi-day search for Rich Moore, 71, of Pagosa Springs, missing since Aug 19, 2023 on a Blackhead Peak hike (body found Oct 30, 2023 — recorded as id 1308); this Alpine assist is recorded separately at its mission date.
